description: Covers full cost of replaced vehicle parts without depreciation.
Protects against engine damage from water ingression or oil leakage.
24x7 help in case of vehicle breakdown, towing, or fuel shortage.
Pays the difference between insured value and invoice value during total loss.
Keeps NCB intact even after a single claim in a policy year.
Covers small consumable parts like nuts, bolts, and oil in case of a claim.
Covers repair or replacement of damaged tyres and tubes.
Covers cost of replacing lost or stolen keys and locks.
Provides additional cover for passengers traveling in the insured vehicle.
Covers the owner-driver for accidental death or permanent disability.
Provides daily transport allowance when the vehicle is in repair.
Compensates for theft or damage of personal items kept in the vehicle.
Covers accommodation and travel costs in case of a major breakdown.
Restores full invoice value for total loss or theft of vehicle.
Insures additional electrical accessories fitted in the vehicle.
Insures non-electrical accessories such as seat covers or alloy wheels.
Reimburses the depreciation deducted during parts replacement.
Extensive protection for internal engine and gearbox failures.
Provides on-road fuel delivery service in case of an empty tank.
Covers cost of towing vehicle to the nearest garage after breakdown.
Covers legal liability towards employed paid driver.
Provides daily cash allowance during hospitalization post accident.
Reimburses ambulance charges in case of an accident.
Covers advanced mechanical breakdown protection for engines.
Provides return of vehicle value at market price upon total loss.
Provides temporary replacement vehicle during major repair.
Covers damage caused by hydrostatic lock due to flooding.
Covers full invoice value minus depreciation during total loss.
Additional personal accident cover for hired or employed driver.
Covers daily allowance when the vehicle is under repair at a garage.
